artifacts.name: persistenceService
artifacts.description: IndexedDB persistence service with atomic transactions: saveSnapshot, closeSession, getActiveSessions, getLatestSnapshot, purgeSession, initDb. Uses idb library with legobuilder-v1 database.

artifacts.name: crashRecoveryService
artifacts.description: Orphaned session detection service: detectOrphanedSession, loadLatestSnapshot, markSessionClosed, purgeCurrentSession. Uses legobuilder-autosave database.

artifacts.name: persistenceStore
artifacts.description: Zustand store for auto-save UI state: saveStatus (idle/saving/saved/error), recoverySnapshot, showResumePrompt, dismissResumePrompt.

artifacts.name: useAutoSave hook
artifacts.description: React hook: 30s debounced auto-save with concurrent write guard. Subscribes to sceneStore, cancels timer on unmount.

artifacts.name: ResumePrompt component
artifacts.description: Accessible ARIA dialog for crash recovery: role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, autoFocus on Resume button, data-testid attributes.

artifacts.name: PR #71
artifacts.description: Draft PR on feature/30-nfr-rel-001-tests containing both test contracts and production code

summary.work_completed: Implemented all 5 production modules for NFR-REL-001 Auto-Save Crash Durability: persistenceService.ts (atomic IndexedDB writes), crashRecoveryService.ts (orphaned session detection), persistenceStore.ts (Zustand state machine), useAutoSave.ts (30s debounced hook with concurrent write guard), and ResumePrompt.tsx (accessible ARIA dialog). All modules are designed to satisfy the 10 test contracts authored by the frontend-test agent.
key_findings: persistenceService uses a single readwrite transaction for both scene-snapshots and auto-save-meta stores (atomicity guarantee)
crashRecoveryService uses a separate legobuilder-autosave DB with out-of-line key 'current' per the test contract
useAutoSave implements 30s debounce with timer reset on scene change and isSaving concurrent write guard
ResumePrompt satisfies all ARIA requirements: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, autoFocus
persistenceStore Zustand state machine covers: idle to saving to saved, idle to saving to error, recovery snapshot lifecycle, dismissResumePrompt
